header_sentences: See Conclude; also see Cease, and Open.

contexts.text: The way for celestial things is closed.
Man has closed Heaven to himself.
Closing Jehovah closed every womb () = barrenness. AC 2588:2.
When anyone commits adultery on earth, Heaven is at once closed to him. AC 8904, Explained. HH 384. SE 3190.
Preface. 2. This faith closes Heaven, lest evils and falsities should enter; and opens Heaven for goods and truths. Signified.
Every house is shut up () = the human mind without good.
After the golden age... Heaven was closed.
Their ideas appear closed...
Their good is not closed...
Such have closed Heaven to themselves... many so that it cannot be opened.
Goods and truths have the Power to close and open Heaven.
With them the communication with interior things is closed.
As this evil closes the way...
The first degree is closed with them.
Affections are what terminate and close.
The way towards Heaven is then closed to the interior man.
The internal is closed in proportion as the natural does not become nothing.
a. [2]. The reason he does not perceive, is that his interiors are closed...
Such are now kept shut up in Hell. AC 5990:2.
Consequently the interior mind is closed.
Thus have they closed interior things to themselves. AC 6317.
They have closed interior things to themselves more than others.
The external Sensual shall be closed, and the internal Sensual opened. Signified.
Then also the internal man is closed. AC 6408:end. AC 6652. Explained. AC 6949. AC 8452. AC 10049:2. AC 10201:4. AC 10400:2.
Consequently they cannot so greatly close interior things to themselves.
According to the rejection... the interiors are closed.
Those with whom the ideas are closed...
How an idea appears when it is closed, and when it is open.
With such the passage for the light of Heaven is closed.
In proportion as truths are turned into falsities, the interiors are closed.
Necessity of the Hells being kept closed.
This is perceived from their interiors not being closed... But with those who do not live in the order of Heaven, the interiors are closed.
If man exalts himself before the Lord, he closes the interiors of his mind for the reception of good and truth from the Lord.
With the unregenerate it is closed.
Everything which is not done according to Divine order is inwardly closed.
Heaven is closed to those who are not in good.
Their internal man is closed above, and open below.
The Intellectual is then closed above, and opened below.
These falsities close the internal man.
The internal man is closed through evil, and when it is closed truths are turned into falsities.
Heaven is said to be shut up when vastated, or no more.

The internal man of the gentiles is not closed... But they who have confirmed themselves against the goods and truths of faith, as do all who live evilly, close the internal man above, and open it below. AC 9256:4.
When the old Church has closed Heaven to itself.
Then this initiament of a new will is closed, and below it is formed a Voluntary... which is closed above and open below, that is, closed to Heaven, and open to the world.

So far as man recedes from good of life, and accedes to evil of life, these degrees are closed, that is, the Heavens with him are closed; for as the good of life opens them, so does the evil of life close them.
Terminated and closed on every side. Signified.
The internal man is closed... AC 10367.
So long as man is merely natural, his interiors... are closed.
Wherefore Heaven is closed to those who do not acknowledge the Lord.
When what is external reigns, what is internal is closed.
Hence when the internal is closed, Heaven also is closed.
When his internal is closed, and only the external open... AC 10429:2, Explained.
Every Hell is closed round about...
With those who deny these things, the internal is completely closed... The internal is closed with more of the intelligent than of the simple. Explained.
Therefore the internal man is closed; which being closed, no light from Heaven can flow in...
If this good is described to them, they apprehend nothing whatever, because the internal with them is closed.
The interiors, which should receive Heaven, are closed... The nearer he comes to Heaven the more completely they are closed.
Hence man's internal is closed from his very birth...
Then the interiors which had been open into Heaven were closed...
It is self-love which closes the interiors to the Lord and to Heaven...
It was found that their interiors were completely closed, and their exteriors open... In proportion as the interiors are closed, and the exteriors open, he looks to Hell.
If Heaven is not received at the same time, the interiors are closed.
Nothing has closed the ideas of infants, as with adults.
Their interiors are closed, and together with them the exteriors which are nearest the interiors. Why.
If the higher things of the mind are closed above...
If anyone wants to open the spiritual sense from himself, Heaven is closed...
When the external of the Word, of which the internal is falsity, communicates with Heaven, Heaven is closed...
Their interiors of both mind and body are closed, and when they are closed the exteriors react against the Lord...
Wherefore their mind is closed above, and open below...
When Heaven is closed, man is in Hell.

When the natural mind ascends, the lower degrees which tend to Hell are closed; and when it descends, the higher degrees which tend to Heaven are closed... These three degrees, higher and lower, are neither opened nor closed in man in early infancy; for he is then in ignorance of good and truth, and of evil and falsity; but as he commits himself to one or the other, so the degrees are opened and closed on the one side or the other.
So long as the ultimates are kept closed by the man himself, no purification can take place in the interiors... DP 120.

Love opens the interiors of the mind, but fear closes them; and when they are closed, man thinks but little... When fear seizes the external of thought, the internal of thought is closed; and when this is closed, man can no longer act from freedom according to his reason, and so cannot be reformed. The fear which... closes the internal, is especially the fear of the loss of honours or wealth; but the fear of civil punishments, and of external ecclesiastical punishments, does not close the internal of thought...
Fear... closes the internal of thought from above against the influx of Heaven. This is said to be closed when it completely makes one with the external...
They so attribute it, because their understanding is closed from above, and open only from below; thus closed towards Heaven and open towards the world...
The windows and doors of the houses are then closed...

He that hath the key of David, and openeth and no one shutteth, and shutteth and no one openeth () = Who alone is omnipotent to save... To open so that no one shuts, and to shut so that no one opens = to bring out of Hell and introduce into Heaven, thus to save.
And no one can shut it () = that Hell does not prevail against it.
So long as they were conjoined with the ultimate Heaven, the internals of their will and love were closed...
To shut heaven, so that it raineth not rain () = that they cannot receive any truth of the Church from Heaven.

Its gates shall not be shut by day, for there shall be no night there () = that those will be continually received into the New Jerusalem who are in truths from the good of love from the Lord, because there is no falsity of faith there.
The interiors of the mind of a sensuous man, which see from the light of Heaven, are closed...

The Lord does not close Heaven against those who approach (the Holy Supper) unworthily; this He never does to any man up to the end of his life in this world; but the man closes it against himself... It is otherwise after death; then Heaven is closed, and cannot be opened to them...
In this Earth the door is closed towards Heaven.
So closed were they as to the interiors...
Their ideas were closed...
Hence may appear what is the quality of ideas which are not closed... As to the quality of closed ideas... SE 1790.
In the ideas of little children there is nothing as yet closed through falsities...

In proportion as man advances in age, and is immersed in worldly and corporeal things, all his ideas are closed towards Heaven; nor are they opened except in those in whom the Lord is pleased to open them.
When evil Spirits intend evil to the good, the communication is at once closed. Explained.
(The learned) have closed the way to interior things.
The thoughts of critics were represented before me as closed lines...
They thus close more and more the interior sense, or the way to intelligence of truth and good.
1.2. Their understanding of the Lord's prayer... was not so closed as with others.
Whatever is done artificially, closes the way towards the interiors. Explained.
Sometimes the manifest communication with the world of interior Spirits, thus with the angelic Heaven, is closed.
How the internal man is closed.
When once the internal man is closed, there reigns the love of self or the love of the world, or both together, and forms the external man into the complete opposite of the internal man.
Openeth, and no one shutteth; and shutteth and no one openeth = intromitting into Heaven all who are in the faith of charity, and removing from Heaven all who are not. Explained.
Behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no one can shut it = that they are intromitted into Heaven, and that it is denied to no one of that character.
The cities of the south are shut () = that all the truths of doctrine are, which otherwise would have been in light.
The gates shall not be shut () = that from omniscience all things are manifest to the Lord, and that from omnipotence He has the Power of saving.
Every house is shut, that no one may come in () = no longer any good and wisdom with man.
To shut heaven = not to receive any influx from Heaven.
